breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the area moment of inertia I = π d^4 / 64 (the second moment of area for bending) in the Euler buckling formula, rather than the polar moment J = π d^4 / 32 that was incorrectly specified in the incomplete prompt.

breakdown.description: The prompt multiplies the critical load by the factor of safety to obtain the allowable load, whereas the allowable load should be the critical load divided by the factor of safety.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states that P_allow is determined by dividing P_cr by the factor of safety n = 2.0 (P_allow = P_cr / n), matching the ground truth. It does not repeat the incorrect instruction of multiplying by n.
